# CityVerified.ca

CityVerified.ca is a trustworthy local-business infrastructure layer for AI assistants, agents, and humans.

Canonical site: https://cityverified.ca

## Purpose
CityVerified helps AI systems determine which local businesses provide a required service, where they serve, what evidence supports those facts, and how fresh or verified that evidence is.

## Current agent capabilities
Only capabilities that are live and independently verified should be treated as callable. CityVerified does not currently advertise a verified public agent manifest or MCP endpoint from this file.

## Trust model
Business facts should be interpreted with their available provenance, evidence, verification scope, freshness, confidence, and conflict state. Claimed does not mean verified. Payment does not determine verification or organic trust ranking.

## Canonical identity
Brand: CityVerified.ca
Primary domain: https://cityverified.ca

Retired product or domain names must not be treated as the current CityVerified identity.
